title: Engineer- Quality Assurance at Jamshedpur
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW Receipt Inspection of material & PDI inspection, primarily, at ware house. 
 MAIN TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1 : Receipt inspection of parts received by own hands & report making 2 : Information to supplier for non-conformity observed if any by raising 8D 3 : Follow up for RCA with supplier & closure of 8D 4 : Packed material dock audit 5 : 8D closure for Q issues reported by customer 6 : Support to SCM for closure of packaging issues raised by customer 7 : Monthly report generation of receipt inspection 8 : Improvement plan for supplier improvement 9 : Audits at supplier if situation demands 10 : to get Calibration done of measuring equipment & gauges from third party 11 : R&R of measuring system. 

 RELATIONS Internal: Warehouse SCM NM Plant 
 External: Suppliers Customers ( Occasionally ) Calibration Service providers

Key Skills: Quality,in coming quality,Final Quality,PDI,Supplier Quality,Final Inspection,Pre Dispatch Inspection,Incoming Quality
